scenario: LEXP.7.19: `!=` on two whole `Json` values is the negation of [LFAC.2.5.1]'s deep structural equality. Pair p1 holds the same object in both slots with its members in a different order, so `p.a != p.b` is false; pair p2 differs in one array element and fires. Two Pairs plus one Found. PATH PINNED: the predicate evaluator, as in LEXP.7.19_json_equal_in_one_fact: libds `rete/eval.c` `val_cmp`; Mercury `ds.eval` `compare_outcome`. A runtime that compared member order would fire on p1 as well and count 4.
rules_ds:
schema Pair scope logical:
    id: String key
    a: Json mutable
    b: Json mutable

schema Found scope logical:
    id: String key

rule r:
    Pair p where p.a != p.b
->
    emit Found logical id: p.id
